title: Fine-Grained Caching for Diffusion Transformers with Few Calibration Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2512.05134v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion transformers require repeated denoiser evaluations, making image and video generation computationally expensive. We propose a training-free framework that uses a few calibration conditions to construct a fixed, fine-grained module-reuse schedule without schedule search. The design is motivated by an empirical effect along deterministic sampling trajectories: with initial noise fixed, condition-dependent deviations in several module outputs evolve similarly across adjacent steps, so temporal differencing attenuates much of their variation. We term this effect Conditional Common-Mode Rejection (CCMR). Motivated by this observation, we rank timestep--layer--module locations using normalized ratios of consecutive feature displacements and construct a Cache Book through two-stage calibration. translated_title: 基于少量校准条件的扩散Transformer细粒度缓存
translated_abstract: 扩散Transformer需要反复进行去噪器评估，使得图像与视频生成的计算成本十分高昂。我们提出了一个无需训练的框架，该框架利用少量校准条件构建固定的、细粒度的模块复用调度，而无需进行调度搜索。该设计源于在确定性采样轨迹上观察到的一种经验性效应：在初始噪声固定的情况下，若干模块输出中依赖于条件的偏差在相邻步骤间以相似的方式演化，因此时间差分能够衰减其大部分变化。我们将这一效应命名为条件共模抑制。受此观察启发，我们使用连续特征位移的归一化比率对“时间步—层—模块”位置进行排序，并通过两阶段校准构建了一个Cache Book（缓存簿）。第二阶段在记录每个临时比特的索引分数后，用该比特更新仅用于评分的参考，同时保留完整的……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的细粒度缓存框架，利用条件共模抑制效应和少量校准条件为扩散Transformer构建固定的模块复用调度，从而大幅降低图像与视频生成的计算开销。
en_tdlr: A training-free fine-grained caching framework that exploits Conditional Common-Mode Rejection (CCMR) with only a few calibration conditions to construct a fixed module-reuse schedule for diffusion transformers, substantially reducing the computational cost of image and video generation.
